feature: Library tiles at the mock's width
summary: The Library shelf now draws its tiles at least 96 points wide, two to a row in a resting dock, and the picture keeps a 16 by 10 shape as the tile grows, so Tutorial Sample.mp4 and Sample Music.m4a read whole instead of Tutor....mp4.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a screen recording, open the Library section in the right dock.

try.do: Open a recording and look at the Library's Media tab.
Compare with the mock's Library: video.html, Library group.
Drag the dock's left edge wider until a third tile fits on the row, then narrow it again.
Switch to Comps and read the starter components' names.
Collapse the sections above the Library so it has room, then open them again and watch the shelf keep one whole row.
Drag a recording tile onto the timeline and check the picture that follows the pointer.

evaluate: Do two tiles to a row feel right in a resting dock, or does the shelf now take too much of the panel?
Does every name you have on the shelf read whole?
When you widen the dock, do the tiles grow and then snap to three across the way you expect?
Do the starter components still read at a glance at the bigger size?
rough: The tiles are the mock's size but not yet its card: the mock draws a bordered card with the picture edge to edge, the name left aligned in brighter type and the length on a second line; the app keeps a centred grey name and the length on the picture. Filed as library-tiles-look-like-the-mock-s-cards-with-th.
Mock tile at a 256 point dock: 112 by 105 with a 110 by 69 picture. App at its 264 point dock: 114 by 90 with a 106 by 66 picture inset 4 points. The height gap is the mock's second caption line.
At the narrowest dock one tile fills the row and stands about 139 points tall, exactly as the mock's rule does. It is honest but big.
Current keeps its 68 point tiles; only Next has the new size.
